column1: Sets ready = copies of the item's slowest part. B-stock only fills internal orders.

=QUERY(Components!A1:T,"select B, max(S), min(Q), max(T), min(R), sum(P) where A <> '' group by B label B 'Item', max(S) 'Customer needed', min(Q) 'Customer ready', max(T) 'Internal needed', min(R) 'Internal ready', sum(P) 'Pieces left'",1)
